purpose: Own only the pure numeric composition that turns caller-supplied verified stat inputs, normal-bond rate, SP stat-bonus rates, and frozen global mastery flats into the pre-central legacyValues consumed by the central-bond numeric layer.

inputContract.statInputs: Exact caller-supplied {ini,up,starCorrection} per hp/at/magic/df/magicDf/dex from an already-validated selected form.
inputContract.masteryFlats: Frozen Stage 4 globalJobMastery.totals. SP does not replace or infer this value inside the composer.
inputContract.normalBondRate: Caller-supplied verified normal-Fetter rate. The composer does not discover or infer bond semantics.
inputContract.spBonusRates: Caller-supplied verified per-stat SP bonus rates; omitted stats are zero. The composer does not parse descriptions or map property IDs.

formula.roundingBoundary: Normal Fetter and same-stage SP stat bonus are combined before the integer round. Central-bond +5% is explicitly excluded and must remain a later separate rounded delta.

leonSp.roundingDiscriminator: Leon DEF must be 260; splitting the SP +5% into its own rounded delta would incorrectly produce 261.

forbidden: silent fallback for missing stat inputs or mastery flats
completion: The pure composer validates Leon pre-central parity at tolerance 0, proves the combined normal-Fetter/SP rounding boundary with a discriminator, rejects invalid rates, and introduces no generated/frontend mutation.
